name: Replenwise – Reorder Planning & Inventory Forecasting
author: replenwise

sections.description:
Replenwise turns your WooCommerce stock and sales history into a demand forecast and a reorder plan. This free plugin adds WooCommerce → Reorder planning. After connecting, it shows connection status, last sync, next order day, the number of SKUs to reorder and up to five saved suggestions with quantity, supplier and reason. Open the full Reorder Desk to review the plan and prepare supplier orders.

The plugin is an interface to the paid Replenwise service: 14-day free trial, once per store, then $99 USD a month, billed by Paddle. The price is fixed for your first 24 paid months; any tax is shown at checkout. The plugin itself never expires. It does not collect payment or change stock, products or orders.

External service and consent

No request is sent to Replenwise before you choose Connect. Connect opens https://app.replenwise.app/ to create an account or sign in, then WooCommerce asks you to approve read-only access. The app reads your store address, store timezone and currency, products, SKUs, stock, prices and order line history for planning. It does not request customer, billing or shipping fields. WooCommerce’s consent screen mentions customers because its read scope cannot be narrowed further.

The plugin stores a random authentication token in WordPress options. Replenwise retrieves only its store-host-bound SHA-256 hash from your store with the verified WooCommerce key. The store host accompanies each call. The token is sent only in an Authorization header to app.replenwise.app when you visit this plugin page or disconnect. Page visits request the saved summary; they do not run a new plan. There is no tracking, remote script, stylesheet or embedded frame.

Disconnect revokes the app connection, deletes WooCommerce REST keys whose description begins with exactly “Replenwise – ” and removes the local plugin token. Removing the plugin deletes its local options, including its token, but makes no service request and leaves WooCommerce keys untouched: disconnect before uninstalling. Deleting your Replenwise account revokes its binding immediately; remove any remaining keys in WooCommerce settings. If the app cannot confirm a Disconnect, the plugin keeps the token and keys and links to the app’s Data page.

Service terms: https://app.replenwise.app/signup?terms#terms
Privacy and data handling: https://replenwise.app/privacy.html
Service: https://app.replenwise.app/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then install and activate this plugin.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Reorder planning and read the service and data sharing explanation.
  3. Choose Connect Replenwise, create an account or sign in and approve read-only access in WooCommerce.
  4. Let the first read finish. Add your supplier facts in Replenwise and save a plan in the Reorder Desk.
  5. Refresh Reorder planning to see the latest saved summary.
sections.faq:
Is this free?

The plugin is free software. Planning runs in the paid Replenwise service: 14-day free trial, once per store, then $99 USD a month, billed by Paddle. The price is fixed for your first 24 paid months; any tax is shown at checkout. There is no in-plugin billing or plugin trial limit.

How does the service help me decide what to order?

Replenwise forecasts demand per SKU and suggests how much to order to cover your supplier’s lead time and review period, with safety stock, after accounting for stock on hand and on order. In the Reorder Desk, open a suggested quantity to inspect demand, safety stock, available stock, incoming receipts and supplier rules. On the Suppliers page, add each supplier’s delivery lead time, costs, pack sizes and order minimums. Review and record a purchase order, download the CSV or print the document, then send it to your supplier yourself. Replenwise does not send orders for you.

Does it write to my store?

No. Replenwise asks for a read-only WooCommerce key. Disconnect deletes only Replenwise keys.

Why is there no plan yet?

Wait for the first read, add supplier facts and save a plan in Replenwise. The plugin only displays quantities from an existing plan already revealed in the Reorder Desk. A hidden plan asks you to open the Reorder Desk. Missing or refused recommendations must be reviewed in the Reorder Desk.

What if my host strips Authorization headers?

The app uses the verified connection’s existing WooCommerce authentication mode for the binding read. The plugin’s calls to Replenwise require the Authorization header; ask your host to preserve it. If Disconnect cannot be confirmed, use the app’s Data page.

Where are suppliers managed?

On the Suppliers page in Replenwise, through manual entry or the supported imports. This plugin does not read third-party supplier or purchase-order plugins.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • When you reconnect, the plugin now removes only the old Replenwise API key that Replenwise confirms it replaced. It keeps the newly approved key and all other keys.

1.0.2

  • Listing text: clearer inventory forecasting and reorder planning details, service pricing and FAQs.
  • The plugin now declares compatibility with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and cart/checkout blocks.

1.0.1

  • Connection status now says when store data updates are paused and how to resume them.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: explicit consent, read-only saved plan summary and disconnect.
